themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: Meta narrowed 2026 capex to $135 to $145 billion from $130 to $145 billion, spent $34.9 billion in Q3 with about negative $2.1 billion of free cash flow, and gave no 2027 number (Oct 21). It will issue non voting Class C shares to help fund AI. Lam Research posted record revenue of $8.22 billion but guided December to $8.60 billion, plus or minus $400 million, only in line, citing supply limits and lower China sales; it fell about 7% to 8% overnight. The spending floor rose, but the biggest buyer is now cash negative, and investors sold every AI report.
themes.for_you: NVDA moved up to 'Buy zone now' at 221.97 on Oct 21 and MRVL stays there at 244.76; wait for a calm close after today's gap before a small tranche. LRCX is Wait at 260.81, below its zone, and near its 254.48 thesis line. META is left out of both lists: more spending helps the chain, but negative cash flow and a new share class weigh on META itself.

themes.name: Defense, drones and reshoring
themes.what: Lockheed Martin reported Q3 on Oct 22: sales $20.7 billion, up from $18.6 billion, EPS $7.97 against about $7.50 expected, and a record $292.0 billion backlog that includes $52.5 billion from the multiyear PAC-3 MSE interceptor award. It raised 2026 guidance to sales of about $80 to $82 billion and EPS of $30.35 to $30.75, and raised its dividend for the 24th straight year. Interceptor replacement money is now locked in for years.
themes.for_you: LMT closed at 551.51 on Oct 21, inside its 543.22 to 555.53 buy zone, but is 'Buy zone, wait for the chart' because sellers led (up/down 0.95). A strong close on heavy volume after the report could flip it; buy only after that close.

themes.name: Robotics, Automation and Physical AI
themes.what: Tesla said on its Oct 21 call that Optimus production has started on high volume lines in Fremont, with Musk warning the early ramp will be slow and bumpy, and that it aims to deliver the first Cybercab robotaxis to customers by Dec 31 and launch in Dallas next month. It also cut 2026 capex to about $20 billion from more than $25 billion. Q3 adjusted EPS was $0.48 against about $0.43 expected, but the stock fell about 3% to 5% premarket.
themes.for_you: No action. TSLA is rated Avoid at 386.47 on Oct 21. It is left out of both lists: robot production starting is real progress, but lower capex and a slow ramp mean little Optimus revenue before 2027.

innovations.name: Technology
innovations.what: Meta narrowed 2026 capex to $135 to $145 billion but gave no 2027 number and had about negative $2.1 billion of free cash flow in Q3 (Oct 21). The inference build is still growing, but the biggest buyer now spends more than it earns, so 2027 budgets are the test.
innovations.for_you: NVDA moved up to 'Buy zone now' (221.97 on Oct 21) and MRVL stays there (244.76). Wait for a calm close after today's AI selloff before a small tranche. META is left out of both lists: its spending helps the chain but its cash flow turned negative.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.what: Quaest's runoff poll released Oct 21 has Flavio Bolsonaro at 45% and Lula at 44%, down from 46% to 44% on Oct 14 (Reuters). With four days to go, the race is within one point, while markets have priced a Bolsonaro win.
countries.for_you: No buys or puts on NU (15.05 on Oct 21, right at its 15.05 zone top) until after Sunday's vote. A Lula win is the bigger surprise for Brazilian banks.

countries.name: China
countries.what: China's CSI 300 entered a bear market on Oct 22, closing 20.2% below its June 22 peak after 10 straight weekly losses, its first since 2020. Analysts pointed to doubts about AI returns and a deadline on Beijing's push to tax offshore trusts, which may have pushed some large holders to sell.
countries.for_you: No action. Chinese ADRs are not on the buy zone list. Selling in China adds to pressure on US chip names with big China sales, such as LRCX, whose China share is set to fall.

countries.name: European Union
countries.what: France's 10 year yield touched 5% on Oct 21, up 8 basis points on the day and its highest since 2002, and rose to about 5.10% on Oct 22 as unrest and the stalled budget weighed. The gap over German bonds is near its widest since 2011. Moody's reviews France's Aa3 negative rating on Oct 23.
countries.for_you: No action. No dashboard name is French. Wait until after Moody's on Oct 23 before any European bank ADR.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: A Houthi drone strike on Saudi Aramco's Shaybah oil field killed two people but did not affect operations, a separate attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam killed one, and the US ordered some embassy staff and families to leave Saudi Arabia (Bloomberg, Oct 22). Brent settled at $108.82 on Oct 21 and rose as much as 3.3% to $112.43 early Oct 22. Trump denied the US is negotiating with Iran; Iran says indirect talks continue via Pakistan and Qatar.
countries.for_you: If you hold energy swings, keep the dashboard stops; XOM (178.09) and CVX (226.78) still have buyers leading on Oct 21. Do not add on a headline gap.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.what: The Bank of Korea held its rate at 3.00% on Oct 22 in a 7 to 0 vote but signaled more tightening, saying the timing of further hikes depends on Q3 GDP and inflation. The KOSPI fell 3.52% to 5,533.77, its lowest close since April, wiping out Oct 21's rebound as chip stocks sold off with US AI names.
countries.for_you: No action. KB and SHG are left out of both lists: higher rates help bank margins, but the market selloff and a weaker economy cut the other way.
